app.title: Implementation of GPT-2 in pure CMake
app.author: porridgeraisin
app.description: A CMake-based build of the GPT‑2 model that produces a standalone library for inference, without external Python dependencies.
proposed_tests: Run cmake . && make -j$(nproc) to build the library
Compile the provided demo executable and run it on a short prompt, checking that output is non‑empty
Measure build time and binary size on a standard laptop
Compare inference latency of the C++ library against the Python HuggingFace transformers implementation on the same prompt
